title: A US judge clears two brothers accused of stealing $25M in crypto in 12 seconds, saying prosecutors failed to prove they committed fraud by exploiting Ethereum (Nate Raymond/Reuters)
summary: Nate Raymond / Reuters: A US judge clears two brothers accused of stealing $25M in crypto in 12 seconds, saying prosecutors failed to prove they committed fraud by exploiting Ethereum — A federal judge on Monday ordered the acquittal of two Massachusetts Institute of Technology-educated brothers on US charges …
